doc: Dash -> ability rows (DashFlow, docs/decisions/0010-dash-ability-flow.md). dash.<ground|air>.<lmb|rmb|e|x|q>: {mode: fire (mid-dash) | buffer (to the dash's end; the default for a missing row) | cancel (ends the dash), carry: dash momentum kept into it, variant: a dash-variant name the kit reads, source: what the source hero does}. into_dash.<slot>: the same for Shift pressed during that ability's wind-up or recovery. kit_owns: the dashes (ground, air) the kit runs in its own state, out of DashFlow's sight until it overrides ArchKit.in_dash().

lmb.source: Data: Pyro Pounce is a short dash that stops on impact; no fire during it. Footage (245.53-245.9 s, 0159-0161): a head-first lunge, then he is upright with the nozzle already on the aim. Ours: the hose lights the step the ram ends (or the step it hits a foe).

rmb.source: Data: Embry Bolt has no dash rule. Footage: never cast from the bash; the ram is one committed head-first beat with the arms swept back. Ours: the bolt goes the step the ram ends or hits, from where he stands.

e.source: Data: Heat Shield pulls in nearby foes; the kit's engage is bash in, then spin. Footage: not shown from a bash. Ours: E pressed in the ram goes the step it stops on the foe (pull and shield right at the impact) or ends.

x.source: Data: Flight of the Firefox flies forward; knockback impulses speed it up (momentum feeds it). Footage: not cast from a bash. Ours: X ends the ram at once and the flight takes over from where he is (the row ends the dash first; no kit code for it).

q.source: No source glove; it goes off from the ram like any glove.

lmb.source: Data: no air bash in the source (the jetpack is his only air move). Owner note (23:40): the air dash is a fast poof, balled up for one roll. Ours: the hose lights as the poof ends (he can flame in the air; the 0.35s relight gap after a release still applies).

rmb.source: Data: no air bash; the jetpack allows the shield ability mid-flight. Ours: the bolt leaves from the poof (its speed is kept after it anyway).

e.source: Data (wiki): Heat Shield can be cast mid-flight in the jetpack, his one air move. Ours: likewise mid-poof.

x.source: Data: knockback impulses speed the flight up. Ours: X ends the poof and the flight takes over.

q.source: No source glove; it goes off from the poof.

lmb.source: Data: the flamethrower is a hold with a 0.35s gap between uses. Footage: he walks while firing; no dash out of the hose shown. Ours: Shift rams at once and the stream stops (hold again to relight after the gap).

rmb.source: Footage: the aim lane shows about 0.4s while he keeps moving. Ours: Shift while aiming rams; the bolt still goes on release.

e.source: Heat Shield is instant (owner item 11): there is no wind-up to dash out of.

x.source: Data: the flight is his movement; reactivating lands. Footage: no dash during the flight. Ours: Shift in the flight is held by the hunter's dash buffer and rams on landing.
